entry.title: Lunenburg Water District: the meeting of 8 September 2026 — recording, transcript and our minutes
entry.summary: DEP says every well must meet PFAS limits alone by 2029; blending won't count, forcing plant-vs-buy choice. The recording is on the town’s channel (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wkIczMuIDqA), its captions are searchable, and our minutes are written from them; the video at its timestamp is the record.
